newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania presidential elections-first round results.
newsitem.headline: Romania presidential elections-first round results.

text.p: Here are final results of the first round of Romania's presidential elections held on November 3, as published on Thursday by the Central Electoral Bureau.
The turnout figure was 76.01 percent of Romania's 17.3 million voters. Some 97 percent of the votes for president were declared valid.
None of the 16 contenders got the 50 percent majority required for first-round election. A run-off between the top two men will be held on November 17.
Nine other candidates got less than one percent of votes.

PDSR=Party of Social Democracy, CDR=Democratic Convention, USD=Social Democratic Union, UDMR=Hungarian Democratic Union, PRM=Greater Romania Party, PUNR=National Unity Party, PS=Socialist Party. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
